```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(readr)
```

# Data Import
```{r}
df_deer <- read_csv("data/raw/NC_WhiteTailedDeer_iNaturalist_public.csv")
NC_Spacial <- st_read("data/raw_large/NC_wui_block_1990_2020_change_v4.shp")
```

# Data Summary
```{r}
print(paste("df_deer has", nrow(df_deer), "rows and", ncol(df_deer), "columns."))
print(paste("NC_Spacial has", nrow(NC_Spacial), "rows and", ncol(NC_Spacial), "columns."))
```
